name: CRGRay.companion_correction
statement:
theorem companion_correction {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ)
    (X dX : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) (epsilon : ℂ)
    (hderiv : dX = A.mulVec X +
      Pi.single (Fin.last m) (epsilon * X 0)) :
    dX = (A + Matrix.of (fun i j =>
      if i = Fin.last m ∧ j = 0 then epsilon else 0)).mulVec X

name: CRGRay.exact_reduced_equation
statement:
theorem exact_reduced_equation (u v : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    v - (v / u) * u = 0

name: CRGRay.exponential_kernel_bound
statement:
theorem exponential_kernel_bound (a b : ℂ) (h : a.re ≤ b.re) :
    ‖Complex.exp (a - b)‖ ≤ 1

name: CRGRay.fixed_point_of_norm_bound
statement:
theorem fixed_point_of_norm_bound {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (F : E → E) (a : NNReal) (ha : a < 1)
    (hF : ∀ u v, ‖F u - F v‖ ≤ (a : ℝ) * ‖u - v‖) :
    ∃! u, F u = u

name: CRGRay.integral_kernel_bound
statement:
theorem integral_kernel_bound {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (k h : α → ℂ) (b : α → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hb : Integrable b μ) (hh : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => k s * h s) μ)
    (hk : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ‖k s‖ ≤ 1)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ‖h s‖ ≤ b s * M) :
    Integrable (fun s => k s * h s) μ ∧
    ‖∫ s, k s * h s ∂μ‖ ≤ (∫ s, b s ∂μ) * M

name: CRGRay.l1_limit_unique
statement:
theorem l1_limit_unique {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (u : ℕ → α → ℝ) (v H : α → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (u n) μ)
    (hv : AEStronglyMeasurable v μ)
    (hl1 : Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (u n - v) 1 μ) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => u n x) atTop (𝓝 (H x))) :
    v =ᵐ[μ] H

name: CRGRay.logarithmic_comparison
statement:
theorem logarithmic_comparison {a b r K : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ r ^ K * a) :
    0 ≤ Real.log b - Real.log a ∧
    Real.log b - Real.log a ≤ K * Real.log r

name: CRGRay.measure_limit_unique
statement:
theorem measure_limit_unique {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (u : ℕ → α → ℝ) (v H : α → ℝ)
    (hmeasure : TendstoInMeasure μ u atTop v)
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => u n x) atTop (𝓝 (H x))) :
    v =ᵐ[μ] H

name: CRGRay.phase_degree_le
statement:
theorem phase_degree_le {u : ℝ → ℝ} {s d a C : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ r in atTop, |u r| ≤ C * r ^ s)
    (hlead : Tendsto (fun r => u r / r ^ d) atTop (𝓝 a))
    (ha : a ≠ 0) : d ≤ s

name: CRGRay.phase_degree_le_order
statement:
theorem phase_degree_le_order {u : ℝ → ℝ} {rho d a : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ s > rho, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ r in atTop, |u r| ≤ C * r ^ s)
    (hlead : Tendsto (fun r => u r / r ^ d) atTop (𝓝 a))
    (ha : a ≠ 0) : d ≤ rho

name: CRGRay.polynomial_exp_decay
statement:
theorem polynomial_exp_decay (K c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => C * (r ^ K * Real.exp (-c * r)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: CRGRay.residual_bound
statement:
theorem residual_bound {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (epsilon : ℂ) (phase term : ι → ℂ) (b B : ℝ)
    (heq : epsilon = - ∑ i ∈ s, Complex.exp (phase i) * term i)
    (hphase : ∀ i ∈ s, (phase i).re ≤ -b)
    (hterm : ∀ i ∈ s, ‖term i‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖epsilon‖ ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-b) * B)

name: CRGRay.residual_identity
statement:
theorem residual_identity {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (u v : ℂ) (w h : ι → ℂ)
    (heq : v + ∑ i ∈ s, w i * h i = 0) :
    v / u = - ∑ i ∈ s, w i * (h i / u)

name: CRGRay.vanishing_kernel_integral
statement:
theorem vanishing_kernel_integral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (k : ℝ → α → ℂ) (h : α → ℂ) (b : α → ℝ)
    (hb : Integrable b μ)
    (hmeas : ∀ᶠ t in (atTop : Filter ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => k t s * h s) μ)
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ t in (atTop : Filter ℝ), ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ‖k t s * h s‖ ≤ b s)
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, Tendsto (fun t => k t s) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => ∫ s, k t s * h s ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: CRGProgress.conjugated_perturbation_bound
statement:
theorem conjugated_perturbation_bound {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (T S P : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    ‖S.comp (P.comp T)‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖P‖ * ‖T‖

name: CRGProgress.derivative_of_gauged_vector
statement:
theorem derivative_of_gauged_vector {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (T : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (z : ℝ → E) (T' : E →L[ℝ] E) (z' : E) (r : ℝ)
    (hT : HasDerivAt T T' r) (hz : HasDerivAt z z' r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => T s (z s)) (T' (z r) + T r z') r

name: CRGProgress.eventually_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eventually_det_ne_zero {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} (m : ℕ)
    (U : α → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (hU : Tendsto U l (𝓝 1)) :
    ∀ᶠ r in l, (U r).det ≠ 0

name: CRGProgress.exists_small_tail
statement:
theorem exists_small_tail {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (R : ℝ → E) (r₀ ε : ℝ) (_hR : IntegrableOn R (Ioi r₀)) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a ≥ r₀, (∫ r in Ioi a, ‖R r‖) < ε

name: CRGProgress.gauge_cancellation
statement:
theorem gauge_cancellation {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (T S A D T' P : E →L[ℂ] E) (z z' : E)
    (hST : S.comp T = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E)
    (hgauge : S.comp (A.comp T) - S.comp T' = D)
    (hsystem : T' z + T z' = A (T z) + P (T z)) :
    z' = D z + S (P (T z))

name: CRGProgress.perturbation_integrable
statement:
theorem perturbation_integrable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (R : ℝ → E) (K c C r₀ : ℝ) (hK : -1 < K) (hc : 0 < c) (hr₀ : 0 ≤ r₀)
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable R (volume.restrict (Ioi r₀)))
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioi r₀),
      ‖R r‖ ≤ C * (r ^ K * Real.exp (-c * r))) :
    IntegrableOn R (Ioi r₀)

name: CRGProgress.polynomial_exp_integrable
statement:
theorem polynomial_exp_integrable (K c C : ℝ) (hK : -1 < K) (hc : 0 < c) :
    IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => C * (r ^ K * Real.exp (-c * r))) (Ioi 0)

name: MixedVolterra.backward_kernel_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma backward_kernel_tendsto_zero [NoMaxOrder α] (q₀ : α → ℂ) (s : α) :
    Tendsto (fun r => kernel false q₀ r s) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: MixedVolterra.exists_unique_fixed_point
statement:
theorem exists_unique_fixed_point (c : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ))
    (hsmall : (∫ s, b s ∂μ) < 1) :
    ∃! u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ),
      u = c + integralOperator μ mode q hq hord R hR b hb hRb u

name: MixedVolterra.fixed_point_tendsto
statement:
theorem fixed_point_tendsto [NoMaxOrder α]
    [(atTop : Filter α).IsCountablyGenerated]
    (hdecay : ∀ i, mode i = true → Tendsto (fun r => (q i r).re) atTop atBot)
    (v : ι → ℂ) (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ))
    (hu : u = BoundedContinuousFunction.const α v +
      integralOperator μ mode q hq hord R hR b hb hRb u) :
    Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 v)

name: MixedVolterra.forward_kernel_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma forward_kernel_tendsto_zero (q₀ : α → ℂ)
    (hdecay : Tendsto (fun r => (q₀ r).re) atTop atBot) (s : α) :
    Tendsto (fun r => kernel true q₀ r s) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: MixedVolterra.integralOperator_lipschitz
statement:
lemma integralOperator_lipschitz (u v : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) :
    ‖integralOperator μ mode q hq hord R hR b hb hRb u -
      integralOperator μ mode q hq hord R hR b hb hRb v‖ ≤
      (∫ s, b s ∂μ) * ‖u - v‖

name: MixedVolterra.integralVector_bound
statement:
lemma integralVector_bound (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) (r : α) :
    ‖integralVector μ mode q R u r‖ ≤ (∫ s, b s ∂μ) * ‖u‖

name: MixedVolterra.integralVector_continuous
statement:
lemma integralVector_continuous (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) :
    Continuous (integralVector μ mode q R u)

name: MixedVolterra.integralVector_sub
statement:
lemma integralVector_sub (u v : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) (r : α) :
    integralVector μ mode q R (u - v) r =
    integralVector μ mode q R u r - integralVector μ mode q R v r

name: MixedVolterra.integralVector_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma integralVector_tendsto_zero [NoMaxOrder α]
    [(atTop : Filter α).IsCountablyGenerated]
    (hdecay : ∀ i, mode i = true → Tendsto (fun r => (q i r).re) atTop atBot)
    (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (integralVector μ mode q R u) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: MixedVolterra.integrand_bound
statement:
lemma integrand_bound (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) (r : α) (i : ι) (s : α) :
    ‖kernel (mode i) (q i) r s * (R s (u s)) i‖ ≤ b s * ‖u‖

name: MixedVolterra.integrand_integrable
statement:
lemma integrand_integrable (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) (r : α) (i : ι) :
    Integrable (fun s => kernel (mode i) (q i) r s * (R s (u s)) i) μ

name: MixedVolterra.integrand_measurable
statement:
lemma integrand_measurable (u : α →ᵇ (ι → ℂ)) (r : α) (i : ι) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => kernel (mode i) (q i) r s * (R s (u s)) i) μ

name: MixedVolterra.kernel_bound
statement:
lemma kernel_bound (forward : Bool) (q : α → ℂ)
    (hord : if forward then Antitone (fun t => (q t).re)
      else Monotone (fun t => (q t).re)) (r s : α) :
    ‖kernel forward q r s‖ ≤ 1

name: MixedVolterra.kernel_continuousAt
statement:
lemma kernel_continuousAt (forward : Bool) (q : α → ℂ) (hq : Continuous q)
    (r s : α) (hs : s ≠ r) : ContinuousAt (fun t => kernel forward q t s) r

name: MixedVolterra.kernel_measurable
statement:
lemma kernel_measurable (forward : Bool) (q : α → ℂ) (hq : Continuous q) (r : α) :
    Measurable (kernel forward q r)

name: CRGHalfline.exists_column
statement:
theorem exists_column (m : ℕ) (r₀ : ℝ)
    (mode : Fin m → Bool) (q : Fin m → Ici r₀ → ℂ)
    (hq : ∀ i, Continuous (q i))
    (hord : ∀ i, if mode i then Antitone (fun t => (q i t).re)
      else Monotone (fun t => (q i t).re))
    (hdecay : ∀ i, mode i = true → Tendsto (fun r => (q i r).re) atTop atBot)
    (R : Ici r₀ → (Fin m → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (Fin m → ℂ))
    (hR : Continuous R) (hL1 : Integrable (fun s => ‖R s‖))
    (hsmall : (∫ s : Ici r₀, ‖R s‖) < 1) (v : Fin m → ℂ) :
    ∃ u : Ici r₀ →ᵇ (Fin m → ℂ),
      (∀ r i, u r i = v i +
        ∫ s : Ici r₀, MixedVolterra.kernel (mode i) (q i) r s * (R s (u s)) i) ∧
      Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 v)

name: VolterraCalculus.backward_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem backward_hasDerivAt (Δ h : ℝ → ℂ) (a r : ℝ) (d : ℂ)
    (hΔ : HasDerivAt Δ d r) (har : a < r)
    (hc : Continuous (fun s => Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s))
    (hL1 : IntegrableOn (fun s => Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s) (Ici a)) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t => -Complex.exp (Δ t) * ∫ s in Ici t, Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s)
      (d * (-Complex.exp (Δ r) * ∫ s in Ici r, Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s) + h r) r

name: VolterraCalculus.forward_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem forward_hasDerivAt (Δ h : ℝ → ℂ) (a r : ℝ) (d : ℂ)
    (hΔ : HasDerivAt Δ d r)
    (hc : Continuous (fun s => Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s)) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t => Complex.exp (Δ t) * ∫ s in a..t, Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s)
      (d * (Complex.exp (Δ r) * ∫ s in a..r, Complex.exp (-Δ s) * h s) + h r) r

name: VolterraCalculus.tail_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem tail_hasDerivAt (h : ℝ → ℂ) (a r : ℝ) (hcont : Continuous h)
    (hL1 : IntegrableOn h (Ici a)) (har : a < r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in Ici t, h s) (-h r) r

WasowAnalyticRemainder.exists_inverse_tail_bound
WasowAnalyticRemainder.exists_small_integrable_inverse_tail
statement:
theorem exists_small_integrable_inverse_tail {f : ℂ → E}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ E} {N : ℕ}
    (hf : HasFPowerSeriesAt f p 0) (hp : ∀ k < N, p.coeff k = 0) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      (∫ r in Ici R, ‖f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)‖) < ε

theorem inverse_real_tendsto_zero :

WasowAnalyticRemainder.partialSum_eq_zero

name: WasowPowerSeries.coeff_derivative
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_derivative (F : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (derivative F) = ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • PowerSeries.coeff (n+1) F

name: WasowPowerSeries.coeff_entry
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_entry (F : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (i j : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (entry F i j) = (PowerSeries.coeff n F) i j

name: WasowPowerSeries.coeff_mul_range_left
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_range_left {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (F G : PowerSeries R) (k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (F*G) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
      PowerSeries.coeff i F * PowerSeries.coeff (k-i) G

name: WasowPowerSeries.coeff_mul_range_right
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_range_right {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (F G : PowerSeries R) (k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (F*G) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
      PowerSeries.coeff (k-i) F * PowerSeries.coeff i G

name: WasowPowerSeries.coeff_rank_derivative
statement:
theorem coeff_rank_derivative (F : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (q k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (-((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) ^ (q+1) * derivative F)) =
      -(if q < k then ((k-q : ℕ) : ℂ) • PowerSeries.coeff (k-q) F else 0)

name: WasowPowerSeries.entry_derivative
statement:
theorem entry_derivative (F : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (i j : ι) :
    entry (derivative F) i j = PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (entry F i j)

name: WasowPowerSeries.equation_of_coefficients
statement:
theorem equation_of_coefficients (A P B : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ k, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (A (k-i) * P i - P i * B (k-i))) =
      -(if q < k then ((k-q : ℕ) : ℂ) • P (k-q) else 0)) :
    PowerSeries.mk A * PowerSeries.mk P - PowerSeries.mk P * PowerSeries.mk B =
      -((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) ^ (q+1) * derivative (PowerSeries.mk P))

name: WasowPowerSeries.exists_inverse_of_constant_one
statement:
theorem exists_inverse_of_constant_one (P : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : P 0 = 1) :
    ∃ S : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ),
      S * PowerSeries.mk P = 1 ∧ PowerSeries.mk P * S = 1

name: WasowPowerSeries.isUnit_of_constant_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_constant_one (P : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : P 0 = 1) :
    IsUnit (PowerSeries.mk P)

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.coe_derivative
statement:
theorem coe_derivative (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) :
    (P.derivative : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) =
      WasowPowerSeries.derivative (P : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ))

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.continuous_eval
statement: theorem continuous_eval (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) : Continuous (eval P)

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_C
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_C (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (z : ℂ) : eval (Polynomial.C M) z = M

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_X (z : ℂ) :
    eval (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) z = z • 1

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_X_pow_mul
statement:
theorem eval_X_pow_mul (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (N : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    eval (Polynomial.X ^ N * P) z = z ^ N • eval P z

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_add (P Q : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    eval (P + Q) z = eval P z + eval Q z

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_derivative_eq_sum
statement:
theorem eval_derivative_eq_sum (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    eval P.derivative z =
      ∑ n ∈ P.support, ((n : ℂ) * z ^ (n - 1)) • P.coeff n

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_eq_sum
statement:
theorem eval_eq_sum (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    eval P z = ∑ n ∈ P.support, z ^ n • P.coeff n

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_mul (P Q : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    eval (P * Q) z = eval P z * eval Q z

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.eval_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_sub (P Q : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    eval (P - Q) z = eval P z - eval Q z

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.hasDerivAt_eval
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_eval (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (eval P) (eval P.derivative z) z

name: WasowMatrixPolynomial.isBigO_eval_of_X_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem isBigO_eval_of_X_pow_dvd (P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (N : ℕ)
    (hP : Polynomial.X ^ N ∣ P) :
    eval P =O[𝓝 (0 : ℂ)] (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖ ^ N)

name: WasowTruncation.coeff_mul_congr_below
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_congr_below {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    {F G F' G' : PowerSeries R} {N k : ℕ} (hk : k < N)
    (hF : ∀ i < N, PowerSeries.coeff i F = PowerSeries.coeff i F')
    (hG : ∀ i < N, PowerSeries.coeff i G = PowerSeries.coeff i G') :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (F*G) = PowerSeries.coeff k (F'*G')

name: WasowTruncation.coeff_shifted_derivative_truncation
statement:
theorem coeff_shifted_derivative_truncation
    (P : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (q : ℕ) {N k : ℕ} (hk : k < N) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) *
      derivative ((PowerSeries.trunc N P : Polynomial (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ))) =
      PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) * derivative P)

name: WasowTruncation.coeff_truncation
statement:
theorem coeff_truncation {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (F : PowerSeries R) {N k : ℕ} (hk : k < N) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k ((PowerSeries.trunc N F : Polynomial R) : PowerSeries R) =
      PowerSeries.coeff k F

name: WasowTruncation.defect_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem defect_coeff_zero (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (q N : ℕ)
    (heq : A*P-P*B = -(PowerSeries.X^(q+1)*derivative P)) :
    ∀ k < N, PowerSeries.coeff k (defect A P B q N) = 0

name: WasowTruncation.defect_divisible
statement:
theorem defect_divisible (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (q N : ℕ)

name: WasowTruncation.truncation_isUnit

theorem truncation_isUnit (P : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ))

name: WasowActualTruncation.actualDefect_eq
statement:
theorem actualDefect_eq (a : ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (q N : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    actualDefect a P B q N z =
      (a z - eval (PowerSeries.trunc N A) z) * eval (PowerSeries.trunc N P) z +
        eval (polynomialDefect A P B q N) z

name: WasowActualTruncation.actualDefect_isBigO

theorem actualDefect_isBigO

    (hc : ∀ n, p.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A) (q N : ℕ)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P)) :

name: WasowActualTail.actualDefect_continuousAt
WasowActualTail.actualDefect_small_inverse_tail
statement:
theorem actualDefect_small_inverse_tail
    {a : ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a p 0) (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, p.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A) (q N : ℕ)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P))
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => actualDefect a P B q N ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => actualDefect a P B q N ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      (∫ r in Ici R, ‖actualDefect a P B q N ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)‖) < ε

name: WasowActualTail.exists_inverse_tail_bound_of_isBigO
statement:
theorem exists_inverse_tail_bound_of_isBigO {f : ℂ → E} {N : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt f z)
    (hO : f =O[𝓝 (0 : ℂ)] (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖ ^ N)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r → ‖f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)‖ ≤ C / r ^ N

name: WasowActualTail.exists_small_inverse_tail_of_isBigO
statement:
theorem exists_small_inverse_tail_of_isBigO {f : ℂ → E} {N : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt f z)
    (hO : f =O[𝓝 (0 : ℂ)] (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖ ^ N))
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)) (Ici R) ∧
      (∫ r in Ici R, ‖f ((r : ℂ)⁻¹)‖) < ε

name: WasowPhaseOrdering.exists_common_phase_ordering
statement:
theorem exists_common_phase_ordering {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (G : ι → Polynomial ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (ℓ : Fin p) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ ∃ mode : ι → ι → Bool,
      (∀ j i, if mode j i then
        Antitone (fun t : Ici a =>
          (phaseOnRay p (G i) θ ℓ t - phaseOnRay p (G j) θ ℓ t).re)
        else Monotone (fun t : Ici a =>
          (phaseOnRay p (G i) θ ℓ t - phaseOnRay p (G j) θ ℓ t).re)) ∧
      (∀ j i, mode j i = true →
        Tendsto (fun t : Ici a =>
          (phaseOnRay p (G i) θ ℓ t - phaseOnRay p (G j) θ ℓ t).re) atTop atBot)

name: WasowPhaseOrdering.exists_monotone_tail
statement:
theorem exists_monotone_tail (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P.leadingCoeff) :

name: WasowPhaseOrdering.phase_difference_tail_dichotomy
statement:
theorem phase_difference_tail_dichotomy (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (G H : Polynomial ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (ℓ : Fin p) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧
      (MonotoneOn (fun r => (phaseOnRay p G θ ℓ r - phaseOnRay p H θ ℓ r).re) (Ici a) ∨
      (AntitoneOn (fun r => (phaseOnRay p G θ ℓ r - phaseOnRay p H θ ℓ r).re) (Ici a) ∧
        Tendsto (fun r => (phaseOnRay p G θ ℓ r - phaseOnRay p H θ ℓ r).re) atTop atBot))

name: WasowPhaseOrdering.phase_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem phase_hasDerivAt (p : ℕ) (G : Polynomial ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (ℓ : Fin p)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    HasDerivAt (phaseOnRay p G θ ℓ)
      ((((1/(p : ℝ)) * r ^ (1/(p : ℝ)-1) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (((θ + 2 * Real.pi * (ℓ : ℝ)) / (p : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        G.derivative.eval (rootOnRay p θ ℓ r)) r

name: WasowPhaseOrdering.polynomial_tail_dichotomy
statement:
theorem polynomial_tail_dichotomy (P : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, MonotoneOn (fun r => P.eval r) (Ici a) ∨
      (AntitoneOn (fun r => P.eval r) (Ici a) ∧
        Tendsto (fun r => P.eval r) atTop atBot)

theorem root_polynomial_tail_dichotomy (P : Polynomial ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧
      (MonotoneOn (fun r => P.eval (r ^ s)) (Ici a) ∨
      (AntitoneOn (fun r => P.eval (r ^ s)) (Ici a) ∧
        Tendsto (fun r => P.eval (r ^ s)) atTop atBot))

theorem eval_sub_polynomialPart (a : RatFunc ℂ) (z : ℂ) (hz : a.denom.eval z ≠ 0) :

      a.denom.eval z ≠ 0 ∧
      ‖RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℂ) z a - (polynomialPart a).eval z‖ ≤ C / ‖z‖

name: WasowRational.exists_ray_polynomial_part
statement:
theorem exists_ray_polynomial_part (a : RatFunc ℂ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ θ : ℝ,
      ContinuousOn (residualOnRay a θ) (Ici R) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r → a.denom.eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0 ∧
        (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℂ) (ray θ r) a -
          Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (polynomialPart a).eval (ray θ r) =
            residualOnRay a θ r) ∧ ‖residualOnRay a θ r‖ ≤ C / r

statement:
theorem conjugate_shear_apply {𝕂 : Type*} [Field 𝕂] (k : Fin m → ℤ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕂)
    {x : 𝕂} (hx : x ≠ 0) (i j : Fin m) :

name: WasowShearing.exact_transformed_coefficient
statement:
theorem exact_transformed_coefficient {𝕂 : Type*} [Field 𝕂] (k : Fin m → ℤ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕂) {x : 𝕂} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    inverseShear k x * A * shear k x - inverseShear k x * derivativeShear k x =
      (show Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕂 from fun i j => x ^ (k j-k i) * A i j) - Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (k i : 𝕂) / x)

    (mode : Fin m → Bool) (q : Fin m → ℝ → ℂ) (hq : ∀ i, Continuous (q i))
    (dq : Fin m → ℝ → ℂ) (hdq : ∀ i r, a < r → HasDerivAt (q i) (dq i r) r)
    (hord : ∀ i, if mode i then Antitone (fun t : Ici a => (q i t).re)
      else Monotone (fun t : Ici a => (q i t).re))
    (hdecay : ∀ i, mode i = true →
      Tendsto (fun r : Ici a => (q i r).re) atTop atBot)
    (R : Ici a → (Fin m → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (Fin m → ℂ)) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hL1 : Integrable (fun s : Ici a => ‖R s‖))
    (hsmall : (∫ s : Ici a, ‖R s‖) < 1)
    (v : Fin m → ℂ) (hcompat : ∀ i r, a < r → dq i r * v i = 0) :
    ∃ u : Ici a →ᵇ (Fin m → ℂ),
      (∀ r i, u r i = v i + ∫ s : Ici a,
        MixedVolterra.kernel (mode i) (fun t : Ici a => q i t) r s * (R s (u s)) i) ∧
      Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 v) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, a < r → HasDerivAt (extend a u)
        (fun i => dq i r * extend a u r i + (extend a R r (extend a u r)) i) r

    (hord : ∀ i, if mode i then
      Antitone (fun t : Ici a => (Q i t-Q j t).re)
      else Monotone (fun t : Ici a => (Q i t-Q j t).re))
    (hdecay : ∀ i, mode i = true →
      Tendsto (fun r : Ici a => (Q i r-Q j r).re) atTop atBot)
    (R : Ici a → (Fin m → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (Fin m → ℂ)) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hL1 : Integrable (fun s : Ici a => ‖R s‖))
    (hsmall : (∫ s : Ici a, ‖R s‖) < 1) :
    ∃ u : Ici a →ᵇ (Fin m → ℂ),
      (∀ r i, u r i = (Pi.single j (1 : ℂ) : Fin m → ℂ) i + ∫ s : Ici a,
        MixedVolterra.kernel (mode i) (fun t : Ici a => Q i t-Q j t) r s * (R s (u s)) i) ∧
      Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 (Pi.single j (1 : ℂ) : Fin m → ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, a < r → HasDerivAt (extend a u)
        (fun i => (dQ i r-dQ j r) * extend a u r i +
          (extend a R r (extend a u r)) i) r

theorem exists_fundamental_matrix (m : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (mode : Fin m → Fin m → Bool) (Q dQ : Fin m → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ i, Continuous (Q i))
    (hdQ : ∀ i r, a < r → HasDerivAt (Q i) (dQ i r) r)
    (hord : ∀ j i, if mode j i then
      Antitone (fun t : Ici a => (Q i t-Q j t).re)
      else Monotone (fun t : Ici a => (Q i t-Q j t).re))
    (hdecay : ∀ j i, mode j i = true →
      Tendsto (fun r : Ici a => (Q i r-Q j r).re) atTop atBot)
    (R : Ici a → (Fin m → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (Fin m → ℂ)) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hL1 : Integrable (fun s : Ici a => ‖R s‖))
    (hsmall : (∫ s : Ici a, ‖R s‖) < 1) :
    ∃ u : Fin m → Ici a →ᵇ (Fin m → ℂ),
      (∀ j r i, u j r i = (Pi.single j (1 : ℂ) : Fin m → ℂ) i + ∫ s : Ici a,
        MixedVolterra.kernel (mode j i) (fun t : Ici a => Q i t-Q j t) r s *
          (R s (u j s)) i) ∧
      Tendsto (normalizedMatrix u) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, a < r → ∀ j, HasDerivAt (fun t i => fundamentalMatrix u Q t i j)
        (fun i => dQ i r * fundamentalMatrix u Q r i j +
          (extend a R r (fun k => fundamentalMatrix u Q r k j)) i) r) ∧
      ∃ A : ℝ, a < A ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, A ≤ r →
        (normalizedMatrix u r).det ≠ 0 ∧ (fundamentalMatrix u Q r).det ≠ 0

    {a : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {s : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a s 0)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, s.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A)
    (q N : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hN : q + 2 * L + 1 ≤ N)
    (hP : PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1)
    (heq : A * P - P * B =
      -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P))
    (hcoef : ∀ r > Rmin,
      coefficientOnRay (WasowRamification.rationalCoefficient p hp A₀) (θ / p) r =
        rayCoefficient a q r)
    (hcanon : ∀ r > Rmin, truncatedCoefficient B q N r =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => deriv (phaseOnRay 1 (F i) (θ / p) 0) r) +
        ((r : ℂ)⁻¹) • G)
    (hcomm : ∀ r > Rmin, Commute
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => deriv (phaseOnRay 1 (F i) (θ / p) 0) r)) G) :
    ∃ ℓ : Fin p, Nonempty (RayGaugeWitness A₀ θ
      (fun i => phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ))

name: WasowFormalRecurrence.coefficient_identity_of_step
statement:
theorem coefficient_identity_of_step (A P B : ℕ → R) (q k : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hP : P 0 = 1) (hB : B 0 = A 0)
    (hstep : A 0 * P k - P k * A 0 = B k + residual A q P B k) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (A (k - i) * P i - P i * B (k - i))) =
      -derivativeCoeff q P k

name: WasowFormalRecurrence.coefficients_pos
statement:
theorem coefficients_pos (A : ℕ → R) {q k : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hk : 0 < k)
    (step : R → R × R) :
    coefficients A q step k = step (residual A q
      (fun i => (coefficients A q step i).1)
      (fun i => (coefficients A q step i).2) k)

name: WasowFormalRecurrence.exists_formal_block_reduction
statement:
theorem exists_formal_block_reduction {α β : ℂ} (hαβ : α ≠ β)
    {N : Matrix m m ℂ} {M : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hN : IsNilpotent N) (hM : IsNilpotent M)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ)
    (hA : A 0 = Matrix.fromBlocks (α • 1 + N) 0 0 (β • 1 + M))
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B : ℕ → Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ,
      P 0 = 1 ∧ B 0 = A 0 ∧
      (∀ k, (P (k + 1)).toBlocks₁₁ = 0 ∧ (P (k + 1)).toBlocks₂₂ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, (B k).toBlocks₁₂ = 0 ∧ (B k).toBlocks₂₁ = 0) ∧
      ∀ k, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (A (k - i) * P i - P i * B (k - i))) = -derivativeCoeff q P k

name: WasowFormalRecurrence.exists_step
statement:
theorem exists_step {α β : ℂ} (hαβ : α ≠ β)
    {N : Matrix m m ℂ} {M : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hN : IsNilpotent N) (hM : IsNilpotent M)
    (H : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ) :
    ∃ s : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ × Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ,
      s.1.toBlocks₁₁ = 0 ∧ s.1.toBlocks₂₂ = 0 ∧
      s.2.toBlocks₁₂ = 0 ∧ s.2.toBlocks₂₁ = 0 ∧
      Matrix.fromBlocks (α • 1 + N) 0 0 (β • 1 + M) * s.1 -
        s.1 * Matrix.fromBlocks (α • 1 + N) 0 0 (β • 1 + M) = s.2 + H

name: WasowFormalRecurrence.residual_congr
statement:
theorem residual_congr {A : ℕ → R} {q k : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {P B P' B' : ℕ → R} (hP : ∀ i < k, P i = P' i)
    (hB : ∀ i < k, B i = B' i) :
    residual A q P B k = residual A q P' B' k

name: WasowRecurrencePrinciple.exists_formal_reduction_of_step
statement:
theorem exists_formal_reduction_of_step {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℂ R]
    (A : ℕ → R) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (pNorm bNorm : R → Prop)
    (hstep : ∀ H : R, ∃ p b : R,
      pNorm p ∧ bNorm b ∧ A 0 * p - p * A 0 = b + H) :
    ∃ P B : ℕ → R,
      P 0 = 1 ∧ B 0 = A 0 ∧
      (∀ k, pNorm (P (k + 1))) ∧ (∀ k, bNorm (B (k + 1))) ∧
      ∀ k, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (A (k - i) * P i - P i * B (k - i))) = -derivativeCoeff q P k

name: WasowShiftReduction.exists_formal_shift_reduction
statement:
theorem exists_formal_shift_reduction {h : ℕ}
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin (h + 1)) (Fin (h + 1)) ℂ)
    (hA : A 0 = shift h) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B : ℕ → Matrix (Fin (h + 1)) (Fin (h + 1)) ℂ,
      P 0 = 1 ∧ B 0 = A 0 ∧
      (∀ k j, P (k + 1) 0 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ k i j, i.val < h → B (k + 1) i j = 0) ∧
      ∀ k, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (A (k - i) * P i - P i * B (k - i))) =
          -WasowFormalRecurrence.derivativeCoeff q P k

name: WasowShiftReduction.exists_rectangular_step
statement:
theorem exists_rectangular_step {h k : ℕ} (K : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ)
    (H : Matrix (Fin (h + 1)) (Fin k) ℂ) :
    ∃ P B : Matrix (Fin (h + 1)) (Fin k) ℂ,
      (∀ j, P 0 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, i.val < h → B i j = 0) ∧
      shift h * P - P * K = B + H

name: WasowMultiShiftReduction.exists_formal_multishift_reduction

      P 0 = 1 ∧ B 0 = A 0 ∧
      (∀ k a b j, P (k + 1) ⟨a, 0⟩ ⟨b, j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k a b i j, i.val < h a → B (k + 1) ⟨a, i⟩ ⟨b, j⟩ = 0) ∧

name: WasowMultiShiftReduction.exists_multishift_step
statement:
theorem exists_multishift_step (h : σ → ℕ)
    (H : Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) :

name: WasowMultiBlockReduction.exists_formal_multiblock_reduction
statement:
theorem exists_formal_multiblock_reduction (h : σ → ℕ) (eigenvalue : σ → ℂ)
    (N : ∀ a, Matrix (Fin (h a+1)) (Fin (h a+1)) ℂ)
    (heigenvalue : Function.Injective eigenvalue) (hN : ∀ a, IsNilpotent (N a))
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0 = leading h eigenvalue N)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ,
      P 0 = 1 ∧ B 0 = A 0 ∧
      (∀ k a i j, P (k+1) ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨a,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k a b, a ≠ b → ∀ i j, B k ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      ∀ k, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (A (k-i) * P i - P i * B (k-i))) =
        -WasowFormalRecurrence.derivativeCoeff q P k

name: WasowMultiBlockReduction.exists_multiblock_step
statement:
theorem exists_multiblock_step (h : σ → ℕ) (eigenvalue : σ → ℂ)
    (N : ∀ a, Matrix (Fin (h a+1)) (Fin (h a+1)) ℂ)
    (heigenvalue : Function.Injective eigenvalue) (hN : ∀ a, IsNilpotent (N a))
    (H : Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) :
    ∃ P B : Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ,
      (∀ a i j, P ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨a,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ a b, a ≠ b → ∀ i j, B ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      leading h eigenvalue N * P - P * leading h eigenvalue N = B + H

name: WasowFormalSeries.exists_block_powerSeries
statement:
theorem exists_block_powerSeries {α β : ℂ} (hαβ : α ≠ β)
    {N : Matrix m m ℂ} {M : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hN : IsNilpotent N) (hM : IsNilpotent M)
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ))
    (hA : PowerSeries.constantCoeff A = Matrix.fromBlocks (α • 1 + N) 0 0 (β • 1 + M))
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B S : PowerSeries (Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1 ∧ IsUnit P ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = PowerSeries.constantCoeff A ∧
      (∀ k, (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) P).toBlocks₁₁ = 0 ∧
        (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) P).toBlocks₂₂ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, (PowerSeries.coeff k B).toBlocks₁₂ = 0 ∧
        (PowerSeries.coeff k B).toBlocks₂₁ = 0) ∧
      S * P = 1 ∧ P * S = 1 ∧
      A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) * derivative P)

name: WasowFormalSeries.exists_multiblock_powerSeries
statement:
theorem exists_multiblock_powerSeries {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (h : σ → ℕ) (eigenvalue : σ → ℂ)
    (N : ∀ a, Matrix (Fin (h a+1)) (Fin (h a+1)) ℂ)
    (heigenvalue : Function.Injective eigenvalue) (hN : ∀ a, IsNilpotent (N a))
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ))
    (hA : PowerSeries.constantCoeff A = WasowMultiBlockReduction.leading h eigenvalue N)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B S : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1 ∧ IsUnit P ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = PowerSeries.constantCoeff A ∧
      (∀ k a i j, (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) P) ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨a,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k a b, a ≠ b → ∀ i j, (PowerSeries.coeff k B) ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      S * P = 1 ∧ P * S = 1 ∧
      A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) * derivative P)

name: WasowFormalSeries.exists_multishift_powerSeries
statement:
theorem exists_multishift_powerSeries {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (h : σ → ℕ)
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ))
    (hA : PowerSeries.constantCoeff A = WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B S : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1 ∧ IsUnit P ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = PowerSeries.constantCoeff A ∧
      (∀ k a b j, (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) P) ⟨a,0⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k a b i j, i.val < h a → (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) B) ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      S * P = 1 ∧ P * S = 1 ∧
      A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) * derivative P)

name: WasowArbitraryFormalBlocks.exists_arbitrary_formal_block_reduction

theorem exists_arbitrary_formal_block_reduction (A : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B S : PowerSeries (Matrix (BlockIndex A) (BlockIndex A) ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1 ∧ IsUnit P ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = PowerSeries.constantCoeff (coordinateSeries A) ∧

name: WasowShearingLeading.derivative_correction_positive
statement:
theorem derivative_correction_positive {q : ℕ} {σ : ℚ}
    (hσ : σ < (q+1 : ℕ)) : 0 < (q+1 : ℕ)-σ

name: WasowShearingLeading.exists_leading_slope
statement:
theorem exists_leading_slope (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (q : ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, j ≤ i → A 0 i j = 0) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ, 0 < σ ∧ σ ≤ (q+1 : ℕ) ∧
      (∀ k i j, A k i j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ weightedDegree σ k i j) ∧
      (σ = (q+1 : ℕ) ∨ ∃ k i j, j ≤ i ∧
        A k i j ≠ 0 ∧ weightedDegree σ k i j = 0)

name: WasowShearingLeading.exists_slope_with_leading_feedback
statement:
theorem exists_slope_with_leading_feedback
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (q : ℕ)
    (hshape : ∀ i j, A 0 i j ≠ 0 → j.val = i.val+1) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ, 0 < σ ∧ σ ≤ (q+1 : ℕ) ∧
      (∀ k i j, A k i j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ weightedDegree σ k i j) ∧
      (σ = (q+1 : ℕ) ∨ ∃ i j, j ≤ i ∧ leadingMatrix A σ i j ≠ 0)

name: WasowShearingLeading.firstOrder_le
statement:
theorem firstOrder_le (v : ℕ → ℂ) {k : ℕ} (hk : v k ≠ 0) :
    firstOrder v ≤ k

name: WasowShearingLeading.firstOrder_pos
statement:
theorem firstOrder_pos (v : ℕ → ℂ) (hv : ∃ k, v k ≠ 0) (hzero : v 0 = 0) :

name: WasowShearingLeading.firstOrder_spec
statement:
theorem firstOrder_spec (v : ℕ → ℂ) (hv : ∃ k, v k ≠ 0) :

name: WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix_above
statement:
theorem leadingMatrix_above (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hshape : ∀ i j, A 0 i j ≠ 0 → j.val = i.val+1)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    leadingMatrix A σ i j = A 0 i j

name: WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix_diagonal_zero
statement:
theorem leadingMatrix_diagonal_zero (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (σ : ℚ) (hfrac : ∀ k : ℕ, σ ≠ k) (i : Fin n) :
    leadingMatrix A σ i i = 0

name: WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem leadingMatrix_eq_coeff (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (σ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) (hk : weightedDegree σ k i j = 0) :
    leadingMatrix A σ i j = A k i j

name: WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem leadingMatrix_ne_zero_iff (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (σ : ℚ) (i j : Fin n) :
    leadingMatrix A σ i j ≠ 0 ↔
      ∃ k, weightedDegree σ k i j = 0 ∧ A k i j ≠ 0

name: WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix_normalized_rows
statement:
theorem leadingMatrix_normalized_rows (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hshape : ∀ i j, A 0 i j ≠ 0 → j.val = i.val+1)
    (lastRows : Set (Fin n))
    (hnorm : ∀ k, 0 < k → ∀ i j, i ∉ lastRows → A k i j = 0)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (i j : Fin n) (hi : i ∉ lastRows) :
    leadingMatrix A σ i j = A 0 i j

name: WasowShearingLeading.weightedDegree_injective
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_injective (σ : ℚ) (i j : Fin n) :
    Function.Injective (fun k => weightedDegree σ k i j)

name: WasowShearingLeading.weightedDegree_ramified
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_ramified (p a k : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i j : Fin n) :
    (p : ℚ) * weightedDegree ((a : ℚ)/p) k i j =
      p*k + ((j.val : ℚ)-i.val-1)*a

name: WasowFormalShearing.constantCoeff_normalizedSeries
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_normalizedSeries
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (a q : ℕ) (hσ : (a : ℚ)/p < (q+1 : ℕ)) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (normalizedSeries A p hp a q) =
      WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix (fun k => PowerSeries.coeff k A) ((a : ℚ)/p)

name: WasowFormalShearing.constantCoeff_ramifiedSeries
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_ramifiedSeries
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (a q : ℕ) (hσ : (a : ℚ)/p < (q+1 : ℕ)) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (ramifiedSeries A p hp a q) =
      (p : ℂ) • WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix
        (fun k => PowerSeries.coeff k A) ((a : ℚ)/p)

name: WasowFormalShearing.constantCoeff_shearedSeries
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_shearedSeries (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (shearedSeries A p hp a) =
      WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix (fun k => PowerSeries.coeff k A) ((a : ℚ)/p)

name: WasowFormalShearing.correction_exponent_pos
statement:
theorem correction_exponent_pos (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a q : ℕ)
    (hσ : (a : ℚ)/p < (q+1 : ℕ)) : 0 < p*(q+1)-a

name: WasowFormalShearing.derivative_correction_clear
statement:
theorem derivative_correction_clear (p a q : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ p*(q+1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℂ)^(a*(i.val+1)) *
        PowerSeries.monomial (p*(q+1)-a) (((a*i.val : ℕ) : ℂ)/(p : ℂ)) =
      PowerSeries.C ((p : ℂ)⁻¹) * PowerSeries.X^(p*(q+1)+1) *
        PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (PowerSeries.X^(a*i.val))

name: WasowFormalShearing.entry_normalizedSeries
statement:
theorem entry_normalizedSeries (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a q : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    WasowPowerSeries.entry (normalizedSeries A p hp a q) i j =
      WasowPowerSeries.entry (shearedSeries A p hp a) i j +
        PowerSeries.monomial (p*(q+1)-a)
          (if i=j then (((a*i.val : ℕ) : ℂ)/(p : ℂ)) else 0)

name: WasowFormalShearing.entry_ramifiedSeries
statement:
theorem entry_ramifiedSeries (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a q : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    WasowPowerSeries.entry (ramifiedSeries A p hp a q) i j =
      PowerSeries.C (p : ℂ) * WasowPowerSeries.entry (normalizedSeries A p hp a q) i j

name: WasowFormalShearing.entry_shearedSeries
statement:
theorem entry_shearedSeries (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    WasowPowerSeries.entry (shearedSeries A p hp a) i j =
      shiftedExpansion (WasowPowerSeries.entry A i j) p hp (a*(i.val+1)) (a*j.val)

name: WasowFormalShearing.exists_formal_sheared_series
statement:
theorem exists_formal_sheared_series
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (a q : ℕ) (hA : Supported A p a) (hσ : (a : ℚ)/p < (q+1 : ℕ)) :
    ∃ B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B =
        WasowShearingLeading.leadingMatrix (fun k => PowerSeries.coeff k A) ((a : ℚ)/p) ∧
      ∀ i j, PowerSeries.X^(a*(i.val+1)) * WasowPowerSeries.entry B i j =
        PowerSeries.X^(a*j.val) * PowerSeries.expand p hp (WasowPowerSeries.entry A i j) +
          (if i=j then PowerSeries.C ((p : ℂ)⁻¹) * PowerSeries.X^(p*(q+1)+1) *
            PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (PowerSeries.X^(a*i.val)) else 0)

name: WasowFormalShearing.normalizedSeries_clear_powers
statement:
theorem normalizedSeries_clear_powers
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (a q : ℕ) (hA : Supported A p a) (ha : a ≤ p*(q+1)) (i j : Fin n) :
    PowerSeries.X^(a*(i.val+1)) * WasowPowerSeries.entry (normalizedSeries A p hp a q) i j =
      PowerSeries.X^(a*j.val) * PowerSeries.expand p hp (WasowPowerSeries.entry A i j) +
        (if i=j then PowerSeries.C ((p : ℂ)⁻¹) * PowerSeries.X^(p*(q+1)+1) *
          PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (PowerSeries.X^(a*i.val)) else 0)

name: WasowFormalShearing.power_times_derivative_X_pow
statement:
theorem power_times_derivative_X_pow (Q b : ℕ) :
    (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℂ)^(Q+1) *
        PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (PowerSeries.X^b) =
      PowerSeries.C (b : ℂ) * PowerSeries.X^(Q+b)

name: WasowFormalShearing.ramifiedSeries_clear_powers
statement:
theorem ramifiedSeries_clear_powers
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (a q : ℕ) (hA : Supported A p a) (ha : a ≤ p*(q+1)) (i j : Fin n) :
    PowerSeries.X^(a*(i.val+1)) * WasowPowerSeries.entry (ramifiedSeries A p hp a q) i j =
      PowerSeries.C (p : ℂ) * PowerSeries.X^(a*j.val) *
        PowerSeries.expand p hp (WasowPowerSeries.entry A i j) +
        (if i=j then PowerSeries.X^(p*(q+1)+1) *
          PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (PowerSeries.X^(a*i.val)) else 0)

name: WasowFormalShearing.shearedSeries_clear_powers
statement:
theorem shearedSeries_clear_powers (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ) (hA : Supported A p a) (i j : Fin n) :
    PowerSeries.X^(a*(i.val+1)) * WasowPowerSeries.entry (shearedSeries A p hp a) i j =
      PowerSeries.X^(a*j.val) * PowerSeries.expand p hp (WasowPowerSeries.entry A i j)

name: WasowFormalShearing.shiftedExpansion_clear_powers
statement:
theorem shiftedExpansion_clear_powers (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (L R : ℕ) (hsupport : ∀ k, PowerSeries.coeff k f ≠ 0 → L ≤ p*k+R) :
    PowerSeries.X^L * shiftedExpansion f p hp L R =
      PowerSeries.X^R * PowerSeries.expand p hp f

name: WasowFormalShearing.shiftedExpansion_coeff
statement:
theorem shiftedExpansion_coeff (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (L R l : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff l (shiftedExpansion f p hp L R) =
      PowerSeries.coeff (l+L) (PowerSeries.X^R * PowerSeries.expand p hp f)

name: WasowFormalShearing.shiftedExpansion_coeff_at
statement:
theorem shiftedExpansion_coeff_at (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (L R l k : ℕ) (hk : l+L=p*k+R) :
    PowerSeries.coeff l (shiftedExpansion f p hp L R)=PowerSeries.coeff k f

name: WasowFormalShearing.shiftedExpansion_coeff_nonzero
statement:
theorem shiftedExpansion_coeff_nonzero (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (L R l : ℕ) (hne : PowerSeries.coeff l (shiftedExpansion f p hp L R) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k, l+L=p*k+R ∧ PowerSeries.coeff k f ≠ 0

name: WasowFormalShearing.supported_of_weightedDegree
statement:
theorem supported_of_weightedDegree (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))

name: WasowFormalShearing.weightedDegree_zero_iff
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_zero_iff (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a k : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    WasowShearingLeading.weightedDegree ((a : ℚ)/p) k i j=0 ↔
      a*(i.val+1)=p*k+a*j.val

name: WasowMinorExpansion.det_rectangular_mul
statement:
theorem det_rectangular_mul {R ι κ : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : Matrix κ ι R) (B : Matrix ι κ R) :
    (A * B).det = ∑ f : κ → ι, (∏ i, A i (f i)) * (B.submatrix f id).det

name: WasowMinorExpansion.dvd_minor_mul
statement:
theorem dvd_minor_mul {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A B : Matrix ι ι R) (k : ℕ) (d : R)
    (hd : ∀ r c : Fin k → ι, d ∣ (B.submatrix r c).det)

theorem dvd_minor_mul_left {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

name: WasowReductionDescent.degreeMass_strict_drop
statement:
theorem degreeMass_strict_drop {n : ℕ}
    (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (Polynomial ℂ))
    (hT : T.IsLowerTriangular) (m : Fin n → ℕ) (hm : Monotone m)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, T i i = X^m i)
    (hentry : ∃ ℓ a, T a ℓ ≠ 0 ∧ (T a ℓ).natDegree < m ℓ) :
    degreeMass T < degreeMass (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (X : Polynomial ℂ)^m i))

name: WasowReductionDescent.det_diagonal_submatrix
statement:
theorem det_diagonal_submatrix [DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → Polynomial ℂ) (k : ℕ)
    (r c : Fin k → ι) :
    ((Matrix.diagonal d).submatrix r c).det =
      (∏ i, d (r i)) * (Matrix.of (fun i j =>
        if r i = c j then (1 : Polynomial ℂ) else 0)).det

name: WasowReductionDescent.det_principal_submatrix
statement:
theorem det_principal_submatrix [LinearOrder ι]
    (T : Matrix ι ι (Polynomial ℂ)) (hT : T.IsLowerTriangular)
    (k : ℕ) (r : Fin k → ι) (hr : Function.Injective r) :
    (T.submatrix r r).det = ∏ i, T (r i) (r i)

name: WasowReductionDescent.det_replaced_last_row_minor
statement:
theorem det_replaced_last_row_minor {n : ℕ}
    (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (Polynomial ℂ)) (hT : T.IsLowerTriangular)
    (ℓ a : Fin n) :
    (T.submatrix
      (fun i : Fin (ℓ.val+1) => if hi : i.val < ℓ.val then
        (⟨i.val, lt_trans hi ℓ.isLt⟩ : Fin n) else a)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ℓ.isLt))).det =
    (∏ i : Fin ℓ.val, T (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_of_lt ℓ.isLt) i)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_of_lt ℓ.isLt) i)) * T a ℓ

name: WasowReductionDescent.det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_not_injective
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_not_injective
    (T : Matrix ι ι (Polynomial ℂ)) (k : ℕ) (r c : Fin k → ι)
    (hr : ¬ Function.Injective r) : (T.submatrix r c).det = 0

name: WasowReductionDescent.diagonal_initial_minor
statement:
theorem diagonal_initial_minor {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n) (m : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ((Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (X : Polynomial ℂ)^m i)).submatrix
      (Fin.castLE hkn) (Fin.castLE hkn)).det =
      X ^ (∑ i : Fin k, m (Fin.castLE hkn i))

statement:
theorem dvd_minorGCD_iff (T : Matrix ι ι (Polynomial ℂ)) (k : ℕ)

name: WasowReductionDescent.initial_sum_le_selection
statement:
theorem initial_sum_le_selection {k n : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)

    (hr : Function.Injective r) :

name: WasowReductionDescent.minor_degree_le_diagonal
statement:
theorem minor_degree_le_diagonal {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (Polynomial ℂ)) (hT : T.IsLowerTriangular)
    (m : Fin n → ℕ) (hdiag : ∀ i, T i i = X^m i) :
    (minorGCD T k).natDegree ≤
      (minorGCD (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (X : Polynomial ℂ)^m i)) k).natDegree

name: WasowReductionDescent.natDegree_minorGCD_diagonal
statement:
theorem natDegree_minorGCD_diagonal {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (m : Fin n → ℕ) (hm : Monotone m) :
    (minorGCD (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (X : Polynomial ℂ)^m i)) k).natDegree =
      ∑ i : Fin k, m (Fin.castLE hkn i)

name: WasowReductionDescent.strict_minor_degree_drop
statement:
theorem strict_minor_degree_drop {n : ℕ}
    (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (Polynomial ℂ))
    (hT : T.IsLowerTriangular) (m : Fin n → ℕ) (hm : Monotone m)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, T i i = X^m i) (ℓ a : Fin n)
    (hentry : T a ℓ ≠ 0) (hdegree : (T a ℓ).natDegree < m ℓ) :

theorem minorGCD_dvd_two_sided (L : Matrix κ ι (Polynomial ℂ))

      (RInv : Matrix (NewIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ[X]),

theorem exists_slope_integral_or_exceptional
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (q : ℕ)
    (hshape : ∀ i j, A 0 i j  ≠  0 → j.val=i.val+1)
    (lastRows : Set (Fin n))
    (hnorm : ∀ k, 0 < k → ∀ i j, i ∉ lastRows → A k i j=0) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ, 0 < σ ∧ σ  ≤  (q+1 : ℕ) ∧
      (∀ k i j, A k i j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ weightedDegree σ k i j) ∧
      ((∃ m : ℕ, σ=m) ∨
        (σ < (q+1 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ i, leadingMatrix A σ i i=0) ∧
          ∃ i j, j < i ∧ i  ∈  lastRows ∧ leadingMatrix A σ i j ≠ 0))

statement:
theorem exists_slope_with_pencil_descent (h : Fin s → ℕ) (hh : Monotone h)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ a (i : Fin (h a+1)) j, i.val<h a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j=0)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ, 0<σ ∧ σ ≤ (q+1 : ℕ) ∧
      (∀ k i j, flatCoefficients h A k i j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ weightedDegree σ k i j) ∧
      LastRowForm h (shearedLeading h A σ) ∧
      WasowPencilDescent.LowerBlocks h (shearedLeading h A σ) ∧
      ((∃ m : ℕ, σ=m) ∨ (σ < (q+1 : ℕ) ∧
        ∀ α : ℂ, IsNilpotent (shearedLeading h A σ-α • 1) →
          WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (shearedLeading h A σ)) <
            WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (jordanShift h))))

name: WasowOrderedShearing.flatCoefficients_apply
statement:
theorem flatCoefficients_apply (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (k : ℕ) (i j : Index h) :
    flatCoefficients h A k (flatten h i) (flatten h j)=A k i j

name: WasowOrderedShearing.flat_initial_shape
statement:
theorem flat_initial_shape (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h) :
    ∀ i j, flatCoefficients h A 0 i j≠0 → j.val=i.val+1

name: WasowOrderedShearing.flat_normalized_rows
statement:
theorem flat_normalized_rows (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ a (i : Fin (h a+1)) j, i.val<h a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j=0) :
    ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ i j, i ∉ flatLastRows h → flatCoefficients h A k i j=0

name: WasowOrderedShearing.flatten_block_lt
statement:
theorem flatten_block_lt (h : Fin s → ℕ) (a b : Fin s) (hab : a<b)
    (i : Fin (h a+1)) (j : Fin (h b+1)) : flatten h ⟨a,i⟩ < flatten h ⟨b,j⟩

name: WasowOrderedShearing.flatten_val
statement:
theorem flatten_val (h : Fin s → ℕ) (a : Fin s) (i : Fin (h a+1)) :
    (flatten h ⟨a,i⟩).val =
      (∑ b : Fin a.val, (h (Fin.castLE a.isLt.le b)+1)) + i.val

name: WasowOrderedShearing.fractional_single_eigen_feedback
statement:
theorem fractional_single_eigen_feedback (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ a (i : Fin (h a+1)) j, i.val<h a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j=0)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0<σ) (hfrac : ∀ k : ℕ, σ ≠ k)
    (hfeedback : ∃ i j, j ≤ i ∧ leadingMatrix (flatCoefficients h A) σ i j ≠ 0)
    (α : ℂ) (hN : IsNilpotent (shearedLeading h A σ-α • 1)) :
    α=0 ∧ WasowPencilDescent.ShiftDiagonal h (shearedLeading h A σ) ∧
      ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ ∃ j,
        shearedLeading h A σ ⟨a,Fin.last (h a)⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ ≠ 0

name: WasowOrderedShearing.fractional_single_eigen_strict_drop
statement:
theorem fractional_single_eigen_strict_drop (h : Fin s → ℕ) (hh : Monotone h)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ a (i : Fin (h a+1)) j, i.val<h a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j=0)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0<σ) (hfrac : ∀ k : ℕ, σ ≠ k)
    (hfeedback : ∃ i j, j ≤ i ∧ leadingMatrix (flatCoefficients h A) σ i j ≠ 0)
    (α : ℂ) (hN : IsNilpotent (shearedLeading h A σ-α • 1)) :
    WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (shearedLeading h A σ)) <
      WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (jordanShift h))

name: WasowOrderedShearing.jordan_nonzero_flat_adjacent
statement:
theorem jordan_nonzero_flat_adjacent (h : Fin s → ℕ) (i j : Index h)
    (hne : jordanShift h i j ≠ 0) :
    (flatten h j).val = (flatten h i).val+1

name: WasowOrderedShearing.prefix_sum_le
statement:
theorem prefix_sum_le {k l : ℕ} (hkl : k≤l) (hls : l≤s) (h : Fin s → ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Fin k, h (Fin.castLE (hkl.trans hls) a)) ≤
      ∑ a : Fin l, h (Fin.castLE hls a)

name: WasowOrderedShearing.shearedLeading_lastRowForm
statement:
theorem shearedLeading_lastRowForm (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ a (i : Fin (h a+1)) j, i.val<h a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j=0)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0<σ) : LastRowForm h (shearedLeading h A σ)

name: WasowOrderedShearing.shearedLeading_lowerBlocks
statement:
theorem shearedLeading_lowerBlocks (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0<σ) : WasowPencilDescent.LowerBlocks h (shearedLeading h A σ)

name: WasowOrderedShearing.shearedLeading_single_eigen_mass_le
statement:
theorem shearedLeading_single_eigen_mass_le (h : Fin s → ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index h) (Index h) ℂ) (hA : A 0=jordanShift h)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0<k → ∀ a (i : Fin (h a+1)) j, i.val<h a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j=0)
    {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0<σ) (α : ℂ)
    (hN : IsNilpotent (shearedLeading h A σ-α • 1)) :
    WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (shearedLeading h A σ)) ≤
      WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (jordanShift h))

name: WasowPencilCoordinates.card_eq_of_two_sided_inverse
statement:
theorem card_eq_of_two_sided_inverse {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (P : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (Q : Matrix κ ι ℂ) (hPQ : P * Q = 1) (hQP : Q * P = 1) :
    Fintype.card ι = Fintype.card κ

name: WasowPencilCoordinates.degreeMass_coordinates
statement:
theorem degreeMass_coordinates (C : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (P : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex g) ℂ)
    (Q : Matrix (OldIndex g) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (hPQ : P * Q = 1) (hQP : Q * P = 1) :
    degreeMass (pencil (Q * C * P)) = degreeMass (pencil C)

name: WasowPencilCoordinates.degreeMass_translated_coordinates
statement:
theorem degreeMass_translated_coordinates (C : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (α : ℂ) (P : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex g) ℂ)
    (Q : Matrix (OldIndex g) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (hPQ : P * Q = 1) (hQP : Q * P = 1) :
    degreeMass (pencil (Q * (C - α • 1) * P)) = degreeMass (pencil C)

name: WasowPencilCoordinates.minorGCD_coordinates
statement:
theorem minorGCD_coordinates (C : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (P : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex g) ℂ)
    (Q : Matrix (OldIndex g) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (hPQ : P * Q = 1) (hQP : Q * P = 1) (k : ℕ) :
    minorGCD (pencil (Q * C * P)) k = minorGCD (pencil C) k

name: WasowPencilCoordinates.pencil_coordinates
statement:
theorem pencil_coordinates (C : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ)
    (P : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex g) ℂ)
    (Q : Matrix (OldIndex g) (OldIndex h) ℂ) (hQP : Q * P = 1) :
    pencil (Q * C * P) = Q.map Polynomial.C * pencil C * P.map Polynomial.C

name: WasowPencilScaling.degreeMass_scaleEquiv
statement:
theorem degreeMass_scaleEquiv (T : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X]) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (T.map (scaleEquiv c hc)) =
      WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass T

name: WasowPencilScaling.degreeMass_smul
statement:
theorem degreeMass_smul (C : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil (c • C)) = WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (pencil C)

name: WasowPencilScaling.degreeMass_smul_C
statement:
theorem degreeMass_smul_C [DecidableEq ι] (T : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X])
    (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass (Polynomial.C c • T) = WasowPencilDescent.degreeMass T

name: WasowPencilScaling.isNilpotent_unscale
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_unscale [DecidableEq ι] (C : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (c α : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hN : IsNilpotent (c • C - α • 1)) :
    IsNilpotent (C - (α / c) • 1)

name: WasowPencilScaling.minorGCD_smul_C
statement:
theorem minorGCD_smul_C [DecidableEq ι] (T : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X])
    (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    minorGCD (Polynomial.C c • T) k = minorGCD T k

name: WasowPencilScaling.natDegree_scaleEquiv
statement:
theorem natDegree_scaleEquiv (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    (scaleEquiv c hc p).natDegree = p.natDegree

name: WasowPencilScaling.pencil_smul
statement:
theorem pencil_smul (C : Matrix (OldIndex h) (OldIndex h) ℂ) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    pencil (c • C) = Polynomial.C c • ((pencil C).map (scaleEquiv c hc))

name: WasowPencilScaling.scaleEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem scaleEquiv_apply (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    scaleEquiv c hc p = p.comp (Polynomial.C c⁻¹ * X)

name: WasowJordanBasis.X_smul_reversedBasis_succ
statement:
theorem X_smul_reversedBasis_succ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    (X : ℂ[X]) • reversedBasis k i = reversedBasis k ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩

name: WasowJordanBasis.X_smul_reversedBasis_zero
statement:
theorem X_smul_reversedBasis_zero (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (X : ℂ[X]) • reversedBasis k ⟨0, hk⟩ = 0

name: WasowJordanBasis.chainBasis_apply
statement:
theorem chainBasis_apply (f : End ℂ V) {d : ℕ} {k : Fin d → ℕ}
    (e : Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ a : Fin d, Truncated (k a))
    (a : Fin d) (i : Fin (k a)) :
    chainBasis f e ⟨a, i⟩ =
      (Module.AEval'.of f).symm (e.symm (DFinsupp.single a (reversedBasis (k a) i)))

name: WasowJordanBasis.chainBasis_succ
statement:
theorem chainBasis_succ (f : End ℂ V) {d : ℕ} {k : Fin d → ℕ}
    (e : Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ a : Fin d, Truncated (k a))
    (a : Fin d) (i : Fin (k a)) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    f (chainBasis f e ⟨a, i⟩) = chainBasis f e ⟨a, ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩⟩

name: WasowJordanBasis.chainBasis_zero
statement:
theorem chainBasis_zero (f : End ℂ V) {d : ℕ} {k : Fin d → ℕ}
    (e : Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ a : Fin d, Truncated (k a))
    (a : Fin d) (ha : 0 < k a) :
    f (chainBasis f e ⟨a, ⟨0, ha⟩⟩) = 0

name: WasowJordanBasis.exists_cyclic_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_decomposition [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (f : End ℂ V) (hf : IsNilpotent f) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (k : Fin d → ℕ),
      Nonempty (Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ i : Fin d, Truncated (k i))

name: WasowJordanBasis.exists_generalized_jordan_basis
statement:
theorem exists_generalized_jordan_basis [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (f : End ℂ V) :
    ∃ (τ : WasowLeadingBlocks.Eigenvalues f → Type)
      (_ : ∀ a, Fintype (τ a)) (_ : ∀ a, DecidableEq (τ a)) (h : ∀ a, τ a → ℕ)
      (b : Basis (Σ a, WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index (h a)) ℂ V),
      LinearMap.toMatrix b b f = Matrix.blockDiagonal'
        (fun a => a.val • 1 + WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift (h a))

name: WasowJordanBasis.exists_jordan_basis
statement:
theorem exists_jordan_basis [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (f : End ℂ V) (hf : IsNilpotent f) :
    ∃ (σ : Type) (_ : Fintype σ) (_ : DecidableEq σ) (h : σ → ℕ)
      (b : Basis (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ V),
      LinearMap.toMatrix b b f = WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h

name: WasowJordanBasis.exists_jordan_matrix_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_jordan_matrix_coordinates {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsNilpotent A) :
    ∃ (σ : Type) (_ : Fintype σ) (_ : DecidableEq σ) (h : σ → ℕ)
      (P : Matrix ι (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ)
      (Q : Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ι ℂ),
      P * Q = 1 ∧ Q * P = 1 ∧ Q * A * P = WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h

name: WasowJordanBasis.positiveBasis_apply
statement:
theorem positiveBasis_apply (f : End ℂ V) {d : ℕ} {k : Fin d → ℕ}
    (e : Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ a : Fin d, Truncated (k a))
    (a : {a : Fin d // 0 < k a}) (i : Fin (k a.val - 1 + 1)) :
    positiveBasis f e ⟨a, i⟩ =
      chainBasis f e ⟨a.val, ⟨i.val, by have := i.isLt; have := a.property; omega⟩⟩

name: WasowJordanBasis.positiveBasis_succ
statement:
theorem positiveBasis_succ (f : End ℂ V) {d : ℕ} {k : Fin d → ℕ}
    (e : Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ a : Fin d, Truncated (k a))
    (a : {a : Fin d // 0 < k a}) (i : Fin (k a.val - 1 + 1)) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    f (positiveBasis f e ⟨a, i⟩) =
      positiveBasis f e ⟨a, ⟨i.val - 1, by dsimp at *; omega⟩⟩

name: WasowJordanBasis.positiveBasis_zero
WasowJordanBasis.primary_torsion
statement:
theorem primary_torsion (f : End ℂ V) (hf : IsNilpotent f) :
    Module.IsTorsion' (Module.AEval' f) (Submonoid.powers (X : ℂ[X]))

name: WasowJordanBasis.reversedBasis_apply
statement:
theorem reversedBasis_apply (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    reversedBasis k i = AdjoinRoot.root ((X : ℂ[X]) ^ k) ^ (k - 1 - i.val)

name: WasowJordanBasis.sumBasis_apply
statement:
theorem sumBasis_apply {d : ℕ} (k : Fin d → ℕ) (a : Fin d) (i : Fin (k a)) :
    DFinsupp.basis (fun a => reversedBasis (k a)) ⟨a, i⟩ =
      DFinsupp.single a (reversedBasis (k a) i)

name: WasowJordanBasis.toMatrix_positiveBasis
statement:
theorem toMatrix_positiveBasis (f : End ℂ V) {d : ℕ} {k : Fin d → ℕ}
    (e : Module.AEval' f ≃ₗ[ℂ[X]] ⨁ a : Fin d, Truncated (k a)) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (positiveBasis f e) (positiveBasis f e) f =
      WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift (fun a : {a : Fin d // 0 < k a} => k a.val - 1)

name: WasowSortedJordan.exists_sorted_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_sorted_equiv {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] (h : σ → ℕ) :
    ∃ e : Fin (Fintype.card σ) ≃ σ, Monotone (h ∘ e)

name: WasowSortedJordan.exists_sorted_jordan_basis
statement:
theorem exists_sorted_jordan_basis {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (f : End ℂ V) (hf : IsNilpotent f) :
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (h : Fin s → ℕ), Monotone h ∧
      ∃ b : Basis (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ V,
        LinearMap.toMatrix b b f = WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h

name: WasowSortedJordan.exists_sorted_jordan_matrix_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_sorted_jordan_matrix_coordinates {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsNilpotent A) :
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (h : Fin s → ℕ), Monotone h ∧
      ∃ (P : Matrix ι (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ)
        (Q : Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ι ℂ),
        P * Q = 1 ∧ Q * P = 1 ∧
          Q * A * P = WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h

name: WasowSortedJordan.jordanShift_reindex
statement:
theorem jordanShift_reindex {σ τ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq τ]
    (h : σ → ℕ) (e : τ ≃ σ) :
    (WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h).submatrix
      (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft e) (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft e) =
        WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift (h ∘ e)

name: WasowShearingTermination.exists_successor
statement:
theorem exists_successor (old : State)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index old.sizes) (Index old.sizes) ℂ)
    (hA : A 0 = jordanShift old.sizes)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0 < k → ∀ a (i : Fin (old.sizes a+1)) j,
      i.val < old.sizes a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j = 0)
    (σ : ℚ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hcap : σ < (old.rank : ℚ)+1)
    (hweights : ∀ k i j, flatCoefficients old.sizes A k i j ≠ 0 →
      0 ≤ weightedDegree σ k i j)
    (hfeedback : ∃ i j, j ≤ i ∧ leadingMatrix (flatCoefficients old.sizes A) σ i j ≠ 0)
    (c α : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hN : IsNilpotent (c • shearedLeading old.sizes A σ - α • 1))
    (q' : ℕ) (hq' : (q' : ℚ) = (σ.den : ℚ) * ((old.rank : ℚ)+1-σ)-1) :
    ∃ next : State, next.rank = q' ∧ Step next old

statement: theorem mass_le {next old : State} (d : StepData next old) : mass next ≤ mass old

name: WasowShearingTermination.mass_lt_of_fractional
statement:
theorem mass_lt_of_fractional {next old : State} (d : StepData next old)
    (hfrac : ∀ k : ℕ, d.slope ≠ k) : mass next < mass old

statement:
theorem measure_decreases {next old : State} (h : Step next old) :

name: WasowShearingTermination.next_mass
statement:
theorem next_mass {next old : State} (d : StepData next old) :

      (pencil (shearedLeading old.sizes d.A d.slope))

statement: theorem no_infinite_steps (x : ℕ → State) : ¬ ∀ n, Step (x (n+1)) (x n)

name: WasowShearingTermination.rank_lt_of_integral
statement:
theorem rank_lt_of_integral {next old : State} (d : StepData next old)
    (hint : ∃ k : ℕ, d.slope = k) : next.rank < old.rank

name: WasowShearingTermination.step_wellFounded
statement: theorem step_wellFounded : WellFounded Step

name: WasowRankSelection.exists_ramified_rank
statement:
theorem exists_ramified_rank (q : ℕ) (σ : ℚ) (hcap : σ < (q : ℚ) + 1) :
    ∃ q' : ℕ, (q' : ℚ) = (σ.den : ℚ) * ((q : ℚ) + 1 - σ) - 1

name: WasowRankSelection.exists_ramified_successor
statement:
theorem exists_ramified_successor (old : State)
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Index old.sizes) (Index old.sizes) ℂ)
    (hA : A 0 = jordanShift old.sizes)
    (hrows : ∀ k, 0 < k → ∀ a (i : Fin (old.sizes a+1)) j,
      i.val < old.sizes a → A k ⟨a,i⟩ j = 0)
    (σ : ℚ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hcap : σ < (old.rank : ℚ) + 1)
    (hweights : ∀ k i j, flatCoefficients old.sizes A k i j ≠ 0 →
      0 ≤ weightedDegree σ k i j)
    (hfeedback : ∃ i j, j ≤ i ∧ leadingMatrix (flatCoefficients old.sizes A) σ i j ≠ 0)
    (α : ℂ)
    (hN : IsNilpotent ((σ.den : ℂ) • shearedLeading old.sizes A σ - α • 1)) :

statement:
theorem exists_single_successor (old : FormalState) (i : ContinuingInput old) :

name: WasowFormalSuccessor.flattenSeries_coeff
statement:
theorem flattenSeries_coeff (old : FormalState) (k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (flattenSeries old) = flatCoefficients old.shape.sizes (coefficients old) k

name: WasowFormalSuccessor.formalStep_wellFounded
statement: theorem formalStep_wellFounded : WellFounded FormalStep

name: WasowFormalSuccessor.rawSeries_clear_powers
statement:
theorem rawSeries_clear_powers {old : FormalState} (i : ContinuingInput old)
    (a b : Fin (∑ j, (old.shape.sizes j+1))) :
    PowerSeries.X^(i.slope.num.toNat*(a.val+1)) *
      WasowPowerSeries.entry (rawSeries old i.slope)
        ((flatten old.shape.sizes).symm a) ((flatten old.shape.sizes).symm b) =
      PowerSeries.C (i.slope.den : ℂ) * PowerSeries.X^(i.slope.num.toNat*b.val) *
        PowerSeries.expand i.slope.den i.slope.den_ne_zero
          (WasowPowerSeries.entry (flattenSeries old) a b) +
      (if a=b then PowerSeries.X^(i.slope.den*(old.shape.rank+1)+1) *
        PowerSeries.derivative ℂ (PowerSeries.X^(i.slope.num.toNat*a.val)) else 0)

name: WasowFormalSuccessor.rawSeries_leading
statement:
theorem rawSeries_leading (old : FormalState) (σ : ℚ) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hcap : σ < (old.shape.rank : ℚ) + 1) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (rawSeries old σ) =
      (σ.den : ℂ) • shearedLeading old.shape.sizes (coefficients old) σ

name: WasowFuchsianBounds.matrix_solutions_bounds
statement:
theorem matrix_solutions_bounds {m : ℕ} (a R K : ℝ)
    (A T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (haR : a < R) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hTd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt T (A r * T r) r)
    (hSd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt S (-(S r * A r)) r)
    (hA : ∀ r > a, ‖A r‖ ≤ K / r) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ r ≥ R,
      ‖T r‖ ≤ C * r ^ K ∧ ‖S r‖ ≤ C * r ^ K

name: WasowFuchsianBounds.matrix_solutions_inverse
statement:
theorem matrix_solutions_inverse {m : ℕ} (a : ℝ)
    (A T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (hT0 : T a = 1) (hS0 : S a = 1)
    (hTc : ContinuousOn T (Ici a)) (hSc : ContinuousOn S (Ici a))
    (hTd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt T (A r * T r) r)
    (hSd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt S (-(S r * A r)) r) :
    ∀ r ≥ a, S r * T r = 1 ∧ T r * S r = 1

name: WasowFuchsianBounds.norm_le_polynomial_of_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem norm_le_polynomial_of_deriv_bound

    (f f' : ℝ → E) (a R K : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (haR : a < R) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt f (f' r) r)
    (hb : ∀ r > a, ‖f' r‖ ≤ K / r * ‖f r‖)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : R ≤ r) : ‖f r‖ ≤ ‖f R‖ * r ^ K

name: WasowFuchsianODE.iterate_bound
statement:
theorem iterate_bound (hab : a ≤ b) (A : C(Icc a b, E →L[ℝ] E))

        (∀ i j, (A i j).denom.eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0) ∧
        ‖coefficientOnRay A θ r‖ ≤ K / r

theorem exists_fuchsian_rayGauge

    (hcont : ContinuousOn (coefficientOnRay A θ) (Ici a))
    (hbound : ∀ r ≥ a, ‖coefficientOnRay A θ r‖ ≤ K / r)

statement:
theorem proper_rational_normal_form

        Nonempty (RayGaugeWitness A θ (fun i => phaseOnRay p (G i) θ ℓ))

name: WasowPolynomialTail.conjugated_remainder_control
statement:
theorem conjugated_remainder_control
    (T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (L : ℕ) (h : Control T S L)
    {a : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a p 0)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, p.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A)
    (q N : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hN : q + 2 * L + 1 ≤ N)
    (hP : PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧
      ContinuousOn (conjugatedRemainder T S a P B q N) (Ici R) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r → ‖conjugatedRemainder T S a P B q N r‖ ≤ C / r ^ 2

name: WasowPolynomialTail.conjugation_norm_bound
statement:
theorem conjugation_norm_bound (T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (L d : ℕ) (h : Control T S L) {r : ℝ} (hr : h.R ≤ r)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    ‖S r * ((r : ℂ) ^ d • M) * T r‖ ≤ h.C ^ 2 * ‖(r : ℂ) ^ (d + 2 * L) • M‖

name: WasowPolynomialTail.exists_small_conjugated_tail
statement:
theorem exists_small_conjugated_tail
    (T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (L : ℕ) (h : Control T S L)
    {a : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a p 0)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, p.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A)
    (q N : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hN : q + 2 * L + 1 ≤ N)
    (hP : PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P))
    (Rmin : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ Rmin ≤ R ∧
      ContinuousOn (conjugatedRemainder T S a P B q N) (Ici R) ∧
      IntegrableOn (conjugatedRemainder T S a P B q N) (Ici R) ∧
      (∫ r in Ici R, ‖conjugatedRemainder T S a P B q N r‖) < ε

name: WasowFuchsianRealization.exists_approximateRayGauge_of_fuchsian_formal_truncation
statement:
theorem exists_approximateRayGauge_of_fuchsian_formal_truncation
    (A₀ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (RatFunc ℂ)) (θ Rmin : ℝ)
    (J T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (L : ℕ) (g : RegularGauge J T S L)
    {a : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a p 0)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, p.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A)
    (q N : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hN : q + 2 * L + 1 ≤ N)
    (hP : PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P))
    (dQ : Fin m → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hcoef : ∀ r > Rmin, coefficientOnRay A₀ θ r = rayCoefficient a q r)
    (hcanon : ∀ r > Rmin, truncatedCoefficient B q N r =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => dQ i r) + J r)
    (hcomm : ∀ r > Rmin, Commute (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => dQ i r)) (T r))
    (hpole : ∀ r > Rmin, ∀ i j, (RatFunc.denom (A₀ i j)).eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ Rmin ≤ R ∧
      Nonempty (ApproximateRayGauge A₀ θ R dQ (regularTailOperator T S a P B q N R)) ∧
      Continuous (regularTailOperator T S a P B q N R) ∧
      Integrable (fun r : Ici R => ‖regularTailOperator T S a P B q N R r‖) ∧
      (∫ r : Ici R, ‖regularTailOperator T S a P B q N R r‖) < ε

name: WasowFuchsianRealization.exists_exact_rayGauge_of_fuchsian_formal_truncation
statement:
theorem exists_exact_rayGauge_of_fuchsian_formal_truncation
    (A₀ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (RatFunc ℂ)) (θ Rmin : ℝ)
    (J T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (L : ℕ) (g : RegularGauge J T S L)
    {a : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {s : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a s 0)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, s.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A)
    (q N : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hN : q + 2 * L + 1 ≤ N)
    (hP : PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (F : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (ℓ : Fin p)
    (hcoef : ∀ r > Rmin, coefficientOnRay A₀ θ r = rayCoefficient a q r)
    (hcanon : ∀ r > Rmin, truncatedCoefficient B q N r =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => deriv (phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ) r) + J r)
    (hcomm : ∀ r > Rmin, Commute (Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i => deriv (phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ) r)) (T r))
    (hpole : ∀ r > Rmin, ∀ i j, (RatFunc.denom (A₀ i j)).eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (RayGaugeWitness A₀ θ (fun i => phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ))

name: WasowFuchsianTruncation.exists_regular_tail_bound
statement:
theorem exists_regular_tail_bound
    (B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ ContinuousOn (regularCoefficient B N) (Ici a) ∧
      ∀ r ≥ a, ‖regularCoefficient B N r‖ ≤
        (‖PowerSeries.constantCoeff B‖ + 1) / r

name: WasowFuchsianTruncation.exists_truncated_fundamental
statement:
theorem exists_truncated_fundamental
    (B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∃ T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ,
        ContinuousOn T (Ici R) ∧ ContinuousOn S (Ici R) ∧
        (∀ r > R, HasDerivAt T (regularCoefficient B N r * T r) r) ∧
        (∀ r > R, HasDerivAt S (-(S r * regularCoefficient B N r)) r) ∧
        (∀ r ≥ R, S r * T r = 1 ∧ T r * S r = 1) ∧
        (∀ r ≥ R,
          ‖T r‖ ≤ C * r ^ (‖PowerSeries.constantCoeff B‖ + 1) ∧

statement:
theorem exists_scalar_multishift_powerSeries {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (h : σ → ℕ) (μ : ℂ)
    (A : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ))
    (hA : PowerSeries.constantCoeff A = μ • 1 + WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ P B S : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1 ∧ IsUnit P ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = PowerSeries.constantCoeff A ∧
      (∀ k a b j, (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) P) ⟨a,0⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k a b i j, i.val < h a → (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) B) ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      S * P = 1 ∧ P * S = 1 ∧
      A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) * derivative P)

name: WasowJordanFormal.exists_single_eigenvalue_normalization
statement:
theorem exists_single_eigenvalue_normalization (A : PowerSeries (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (μ : ℂ)
    (hN : IsNilpotent (PowerSeries.constantCoeff A - μ • 1)) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ (σ : Type) (_ : Fintype σ) (_ : DecidableEq σ) (h : σ → ℕ)
      (e : Matrix ι ι ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ)
      (P B S : PowerSeries (Matrix (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) (WasowMultiShiftReduction.Index h) ℂ)),
      e (PowerSeries.constantCoeff A) = μ • 1 + WasowMultiShiftReduction.jordanShift h ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1 ∧ IsUnit P ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = e (PowerSeries.constantCoeff A) ∧
      (∀ k a b j, (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) P) ⟨a,0⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      (∀ k a b i j, i.val < h a → (PowerSeries.coeff (k+1) B) ⟨a,i⟩ ⟨b,j⟩ = 0) ∧
      S * P = 1 ∧ P * S = 1 ∧
      PowerSeries.map e.toRingHom A * P - P * B =
        -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q+1) * derivative P)

name: WasowLaurentExactAssembly.exists_approximateRayGauge_of_laurent_regular
statement:
theorem exists_approximateRayGauge_of_laurent_regular
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (RatFunc ℂ)) (θ Rmin : ℝ)
    (Z W Z' : ℝ → Mat (m := m)) (K : ℕ) (z : FiniteGauge Z W Z' K)
    (J T S : ℝ → Mat (m := m)) (L : ℕ) (g : RegularGauge J T S L)
    (E : ℝ → Mat (m := m)) (dQ : Fin m → ℝ → ℂ)
    (heq : ∀ r > Rmin,
      coefficientOnRay A θ r * Z r = Z' r +
        Z r * (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => dQ i r) + J r + E r))
    (hcomm : ∀ r > Rmin, Commute (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => dQ i r)) (T r))
    (hpole : ∀ r > Rmin, ∀ i j, (RatFunc.denom (A i j)).eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0)
    (htail : SmallConjugatedTails T S E) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1≤R ∧ Rmin≤R ∧
      Nonempty (ApproximateRayGauge A θ R dQ (tailOperator T S E R)) ∧
      Continuous (tailOperator T S E R) ∧
      Integrable (fun r : Ici R => ‖tailOperator T S E R r‖) ∧
      (∫ r : Ici R, ‖tailOperator T S E R r‖) < ε

statement:
theorem exists_exact_rayGauge_of_laurent_regular
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (RatFunc ℂ)) (θ Rmin : ℝ)
    (Z W Z' : ℝ → Mat (m := m)) (K : ℕ) (z : FiniteGauge Z W Z' K)
    (J T S : ℝ → Mat (m := m)) (L : ℕ) (g : RegularGauge J T S L)
    (E : ℝ → Mat (m := m))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0<p) (F : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (ℓ : Fin p)
    (heq : ∀ r > Rmin,
      coefficientOnRay A θ r * Z r = Z' r +
        Z r * (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => deriv (phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ) r) + J r + E r))
    (hcomm : ∀ r > Rmin,
      Commute (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => deriv (phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ) r)) (T r))
    (hpole : ∀ r > Rmin, ∀ i j, (RatFunc.denom (A i j)).eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0)
    (htail : SmallConjugatedTails T S E) :
    Nonempty (RayGaugeWitness A θ (fun i => phaseOnRay p (F i) θ ℓ))

name: WasowRegularLeaf.exists_exact_rayGauge_of_scalar_regular_leaf
statement:
theorem exists_exact_rayGauge_of_scalar_regular_leaf
    (A₀ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (RatFunc ℂ)) (θ Rmin : ℝ)
    (D : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)) (L M : ℕ)
    (hL : ‖PowerSeries.constantCoeff D‖ + 1 ≤ L) (hM : 0 < M)
    {a : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {s : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt a s 0)
    (A P B : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hc : ∀ n, s.coeff n = PowerSeries.coeff n A)
    (q N : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hN : q + 2 * L + 1 ≤ N)
    (hP : PowerSeries.constantCoeff P = 1)
    (heq : A * P - P * B = -(PowerSeries.X ^ (q + 1) * WasowPowerSeries.derivative P))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (F : Polynomial ℂ) (ℓ : Fin p)
    (hcoef : ∀ r > Rmin, coefficientOnRay A₀ θ r = rayCoefficient a q r)
    (hcanon : ∀ r > Rmin, truncatedCoefficient B q N r =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun _ => deriv (phaseOnRay p F θ ℓ) r) + regularCoefficient D M r)
    (hpole : ∀ r > Rmin, ∀ i j, (A₀ i j).denom.eval (ray θ r) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (RayGaugeWitness A₀ θ (fun _ => phaseOnRay p F θ ℓ))

name: WasowPhaseRegularGauge.exists_regularGauge_preserving_fibers
statement:
theorem exists_regularGauge_preserving_fibers {β : Type*} (F : Fin m → β)
    (R : PowerSeries (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))
    (hR : ∀ n i j, F i ≠ F j → (PowerSeries.coeff n R) i j = 0)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : ‖PowerSeries.constantCoeff R‖ + 1 ≤ L)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) :
    ∃ T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ,
      ∃ g : RegularGauge (regularCoefficient R M) T S L,
        ∀ r > g.control.R, ∀ c : Fin m → ℂ,
          (∀ i j, F i = F j → c i = c j) →
          Commute (Matrix.diagonal c) (T r) ∧ Commute (Matrix.diagonal c) (S r)

name: WasowPhaseRegularGauge.matrix_solutions_commute
statement:
theorem matrix_solutions_commute (a : ℝ)
    (A T S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (hT0 : T a = 1) (hS0 : S a = 1)
    (hTc : ContinuousOn T (Ici a)) (hSc : ContinuousOn S (Ici a))
    (hTd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt T (A r * T r) r)
    (hSd : ∀ r > a, HasDerivAt S (-(S r * A r)) r)
    (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (hD : ∀ r > a, Commute D (A r)) :
    ∀ r ≥ a, Commute D (T r) ∧ Commute D (S r)

    (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℂ)

    Commute (Matrix.diagonal c) (regularCoefficient R M r)
